purpose: Define preliminary tests for matching flight trajectories against selected NOTAM records.

tests.purpose: Test airport-area trajectory matching for a runway restriction.
required_checks: flight timestamp overlaps NOTAM effective window
aircraft position is near the airport
flight track and altitude are available if possible
tests.notam_text:
RWY 25L/07R NOT AVBL EXC SUNDAY/HOLIDAYS DUE TO 
PREVENTIVE MAINT OF AIRFIELD LIGHTING SYSTEM. 
PILOTS TO EXER CTN

tests.purpose: Test airport-area trajectory matching for a runway closure.
required_checks: flight timestamp overlaps NOTAM effective window
aircraft position is near the airport
do not assume the aircraft used the closed runway
tests.notam_text:
SRY RWY 14L/32R CLSD DUE WIP (PATCH WORK ON BOTH ENDS)
RWY AVBL FOR FLT OPS IN CASE OF CONTIGENCY SUBJ ONE HR
PRIOR CDN WITH ATC

tests.purpose: Identify available trajectory data during a surveillance outage.
required_checks: flight timestamp overlaps NOTAM effective window
check timestamp gaps and position availability
do not treat missing ADS-B points as proof of no flight
tests.notam_text:
LAKPASS MSSR NOT AVBL WI 250NM AROUND LAKPASS 
DUE OPR REASON. DRG THE PERIOD ADS-B DATA OF 
LAKPASS AND MSSR/ADS-B DATA OF OTHER STATIONS 
WILL REMAIN AVBL AT LAHORE AND KARACHI ACC.
NON-RADAR PROCEDURAL CONTROL WILL BE PROVIDED TO 
NON ADS-B EQUIPPED ACFT IN AREAS WITH AFFECTED
SURVEILLANCE COVERAGE.

limitations: This script does not download or inspect flight trajectories.
A nearby aircraft position does not prove runway usage.
A NOTAM match does not by itself prove operational impact.
Missing ADS-B observations do not prove no aircraft was present.
